more_info.overview: Polyoxyethylene (40) stearate is a mixture of stearic-acid esters of polyethylene glycols with an average chain length of about 40 oxyethylene units. Its emulsifying role is to help form or maintain mixtures of oil and water in the finished food. The specified material is supplied as cream-coloured flakes or waxy solid. The specification identifies water solubility as one of its properties.
more_info.daily_intake: 0-25 mg/kg body weight (JECFA, 1973). The limit covers polyoxyethylene (8) and (40) stearates together.
